## `neuro.date.toUTCString`

Instance method on `Date.prototype`.

> Returns a date converted to a string using Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).

## Signatures

```ts
toUTCString(input: { date: <receiver>; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Date.prototype.toUTCString` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
